name: Text Cube Rotate
description: "Your data, ___" where the last word is a 3D prism that rolls a quarter turn at a time — unified, secured, automated, everywhere — with a wind-up and a settling overshoot, faces shading as they turn away.
move: "Your data, ___" where the last word is a 3D prism that rolls a quarter turn at a time — unified, secured, automated, everywhere — with a wind-up and a settling overshoot, faces shading as they turn away.
how: Four faces at rotateX(−90°·i) translateZ(half the line height) inside a preserve-3d spinner. Each turn is back.inOut(1.4) (true function: zero velocity at both ends). A shade layer darkens faces by their angle to the camera, and faces fade out before going edge-on so no hairline shows.
adapt: Edit the four face words; the cube width follows the widest. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves and inline helper eases, scope selectors to the shot, rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate stays a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation of the "Text cube" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
